text: well how is it a topology failure. if u followed along all ive donne is made 4 loop cuts then 6 and expanded them so how is that a failing topology
resolution: Corrected the diagnosis using the live Follow trace: every loop-cut and transform transaction was accepted, and Chamfer Boundary itself successfully resolved the selected geometry as a four-edge open loop and computed a legal width range. Failure even at the minimum width therefore does not demonstrate invalid user topology; it demonstrates a failure later in the Chamfer preview pipeline on valid loop-cut geometry. The current UI incorrectly reports every such downstream preview failure with the same width-specific message, so both the earlier wording and the dialog explanation were misleading.
